subject: Agriculture
title: Extension Services
description: A quick win: understand Extension Services.

hook.text: New seeds were pointless if farmers didn't know how to use them. Someone had to teach.

buildup.text: Agricultural extension agents visited farms to demonstrate planting, fertilizing, and pest management.

discovery.text: India trained thousands of extension workers who walked fields with farmers, showing techniques in person.

twist.text: Extension favored larger, accessible farms. Remote and small-scale farmers were underserved.

climax.text: Where extension worked well, adoption was fast and yields soared. Where it didn't, old methods persisted.

punchline.text: Knowledge was the seed. Extension agents planted it.

quiz.question: What was the role of extension agents during the Green Revolution?
options: Teaching farmers how to use new varieties and techniques
